transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. We're at production lock for The Last Orchard, and per our standard roundtable procedure, I need to ask our rights and music leads to report any confirmed changes to the presentation plan before I can approve it. Let's start there -- are there any confirmed changes we need to record?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I reviewed the revised license email from the Orchard Estate this morning, and there are several confirmed changes that conflict with our current draft plan. The license permits exactly one public screening -- not the two we have planned. It requires 35mm projection, not a digital cinema package. It prohibits any audience or house recording, so audience photography is not allowed. And it requires the credit line 'Courtesy of Orchard Estate,' which differs from our standard courtesy credit. I have not yet uploaded the email to the shared production packet, so no one else has seen these terms.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report confirmed changes on the music side as well. I received the signed musicians' agreement after the rehearsal plan was circulated, and I haven't yet added it to the shared call sheet. The agreement requires a 14-player ensemble -- not the 10 players in our current draft plan. Additionally, the conductor has approved only a 4:30 PM to 5:30 PM rehearsal on October 18, not the 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM slot currently in the plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

decisions.recording_policy: no audience or house recording permitted

commitments.detail: Upload the revised license email from Orchard Estate to the shared production packet so all team members can reference the confirmed terms.
Add the signed musicians' agreement to the shared call sheet so all team members can reference the confirmed ensemble and rehearsal terms.

Update the presentation plan to reflect: 35mm projection, one public screening, no audience or house recording, 'Courtesy of Orchard Estate' credit line, 14-player ensemble, and 4:30 PM-5:30 PM rehearsal on October 18.
